subject: english
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

I __can make fresh__ coffee if you'd like some.
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. No improvement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence *"I can make fresh coffee if you'd like some"* is grammatically correct.
 
• The modal verb "**can**" is appropriately used to indicate the ability to make fresh coffee.
 
• The phrase** "fresh coffee"** accurately describes coffee that is newly made.
 
• None of the other options provide a grammatically correct or contextually appropriate improvement.

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Modal verbs like "can" are useful to express ability, possibility, and permission.
 
• Adjectives such as "fresh" are used to describe nouns and should fit contextually and grammatically.
 
• When no improvement is needed, recognizing correctly formed sentences is key in language proficiency.
